Extra Premier League: Rewa remain third after 1-0 loss to Navua
item.description: Rewa FC remain third in the Extra Premier League standings with 32 points after suffering a 1-0 defeat to Navua FC at the Uprising Sports Ground. The loss ended Rewa’s hopes of finishing second, with second-placed Labasa FC on 38 points and the Delta Tigers having only one match remaining against champions Ba FC.
item.content:encoded:
Rewa FC remain third in the Extra Premier League standings with 32 points after suffering a 1-0 defeat to Navua FC at the Uprising Sports Ground.

The loss ended Rewa’s hopes of finishing second, with second-placed Labasa FC on 38 points and the Delta Tigers having only one match remaining against champions Ba FC.

Navua earned three points from the win, taking their total to 25 and moving them from sixth to fifth place, while Suva FC drop to sixth with 23 points.

Lautoka FC are fourth with 26 points, while Ba have already secured the Extra Premier League title with 39 points.

item.content:encoded:
The Minister for Education, Aseri Radrodro, has congratulated all schools, students, teachers, coaches, parents, guardians and supporters who participated in the 2026 Vodafone Fiji Secondary Schools Rugby Union Super Deans and Weet-Bix Raluve competitions, which concluded at HFC Bank Stadium.

Radrodro extended his congratulations to the 2026 Deans champions, with Ratu Navula College claiming the Under-14 title, Ratu Kadavulevu School winning the Under-15 title, Suva Grammar School securing the Under-16, Under-17 and Under-18 titles, and Lelean Memoria l School taking the Under-19 championship.

He also congratulated Nasinu Secondary School for winning the Under-16 Weet-Bix Raluve title and MGM High School for claiming the Under-18 championship.

Radrodro says congratulations to all young athletes who represented their schools with commitment, discipline and pride.

He says to every team that competed, you should also be proud of your effort, determination and sportsmanship.

The Minister highlighted the important role of school rugby in developing discipline, teamwork, resilience and leadership, while strengthening school pride and community spirit.

He reminded students that, regardless of their sporting ambitions or future career paths, education must remain their priority.

He says never lose sight of your education and continue to work hard in the classroom while pursuing your sporting ambitions

Radrodro also encouraged students to accept both victory and defeat with humility, respect and good sportsmanship.

He acknowledged the valuable contributions of school leaders, teachers, coaches, parents, officials, medical personnel, volunteers, sponsors and partners who supported the competitions.

item.title: Purcell wins two golds and silver for Fiji at ICN South Island Classic
item.description: Fijian bodybuilder Robert Purcell has delivered an impressive performance at the ICN South Island Classic 2026 in Christchurch, New Zealand, winning two gold medals and a silver. Purcell won gold in the Novice Bodybuilding and Over 75kg Bodybuilding categories, before adding a silver medal in the Open Bodybuilding category.
item.content:encoded:
Fijian bodybuilder Robert Purcell has delivered an impressive performance at the ICN South Island Classic 2026 in Christchurch, New Zealand, winning two gold medals and a silver.

Purcell won gold in the Novice Bodybuilding and Over 75kg Bodybuilding categories, before adding a silver medal in the Open Bodybuilding category.

He is part of a three member Fijian team competing at the event.

Agility Body & Fitness Federation President Elizabeth Maki had earlier told fijivillage that the team was heading into the competition with one clear goal, to win gold and proudly represent Fiji on the international stage.

Maki says competing at the event is a major milestone for the team as the athletes take their bodybuilding careers beyond competitions in Fiji.

She says training was one of the biggest challenges in the build up to the competition, but the athletes remained committed despite the demands of their preparation.

Purcell's two gold medals have now delivered on the team's goal, while his silver in the Open Bodybuilding category completes an impressive three medal haul.

ICN, or I Compete Natural, is a drug tested bodybuilding and fitness competition organisation.

The competition gives the Fijian athletes an opportunity to test themselves against international competitors and gain valuable experience on the international stage.

item.title: La Liga: Real Madrid start season with 2-1 win over Espanyol
item.description: Jude Bellingham gave Madrid an early lead before Álex Calatrava equalised for Espanyol in the first half. Espanyol grew into the game and looked set to hold Madrid to a draw, but 21-year-old substitute Carlos Espí scored the winner in the 90th minute, just 10 minutes after coming off the bench to make his Real Madrid debut.
item.content:encoded:
Jude Bellingham gave Madrid an early lead before Álex Calatrava equalised for Espanyol in the first half.

Espanyol grew into the game and looked set to hold Madrid to a draw, but 21-year-old substitute Carlos Espí scored the winner in the 90th minute, just 10 minutes after coming off the bench to make his Real Madrid debut.

Six players made their Real Madrid debuts in the match.

The match also marked José Mourinho’s first competitive game since returning to Real Madrid as coach after 13 years.

During his previous spell from 2010 to 2013, Mourinho guided Real Madrid to the La Liga title, Copa del Rey and Spanish Super Cup.
